body.name: SigmahatH
body.def: On \(\{\widehat p_H\in\mathfrak D_H\}\), set \(\widehat{\operatorname{IF}}_H(c)=J_H(\widehat{\mathbf p}_H)(e_c^C-\widehat{\mathbf p}_H)\) and \(\widehat\Sigma_H=\sum_{c\in\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}}\widehat p_H(c)\widehat{\operatorname{IF}}_H(c)\widehat{\operatorname{IF}}_H(c)^{\mathsf T}\), using the fixed supported-cell and outcome orders.
